screen.reason: The study proposes and evaluates a model fine-tuning method (Scalable Bilevel Data Selection) on benchmark datasets (HealthBench and PatientSafetyBench). While safety-focused, developing and benchmarking a new fine-tuning algorithm does not represent an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
